<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] is criticized for the trailer and synopses of its new season of ''[[Jack Ryan (TV series)|Jack Ryan]]'', which are interpreted to promote a US-led invasion of [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/amazons-jack-ryan-tv-series-212547937.html (Yahoo!)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 43 people are now confirmed to have been killed by [[Hurricane Dorian]] in [[the Bahamas]]. The death toll is expected to rise further. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49616990 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Niue|Niuean]] [[Member of Parliament|MP]] [[Terry Coe]] says there is "growing concern" over the absence of [[Premier of Niue|Premier]] [[Toke Talagi]], who is reportedly undergoing medical treatment in [[New Zealand]] and has not been seen in public since July and, prior to that, early April. Coe says Niue's citizens are concerned that the state affairs are seemingly being conducted from New Zealand, and the island nation's acting premier has held power for an unusually long period of time due to Talagi's absence. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398214/growing-concern-in-niue-over-premier-s-absence-opposition-mp (Radio New Zealand)]
*[[Robert Mugabe]], the [[president of Zimbabwe|second president]] of [[Zimbabwe]], dies at the age of 95. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/06/former-president-of-zimbabwe-robert-mugabe-has-died.html (CNBC)]
*The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[House of Lords]] approves a bill forcing Prime Minister [[Boris Johnson]] to ask the [[European Union]] for a [[Brexit]] deadline extension. The bill will now become law once receiving [[royal assent]] from [[Elizabeth II|Queen Elizabeth II]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49612757 (BBC News)]
*The first government of [[Sudan]] after the [[Omar Al-Bashir]] era is formed, headed by [[Abdalla Hamdok]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/sudan-forms-cabinet-removal-al-bashir-190906083613765.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**Venezuelan political parties waive the multi-party agreement to rotate leadership of the National Assembly annually in favor of allowing [[Juan Guaidó]] to continue in the position for another term. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuela-opposition-parties-back-guaido-as-congress-chief-in-2020-idUSKCN1VR2FS (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*A [[denial-of-service attack]] takes down [[Wikipedia]], with users unable to access the [[encyclopedia]] in [[Europe]] and parts of the [[Middle East]]. The [[Wikimedia Foundation]] blames a "massive and very broad" [[distributed denial of service attack]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/wikipedia-down-not-working-google-stopped-page-loading-encyclopedia-a9095236.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.dw.com/en/malicious-attack-takes-wikipedia-offline-in-germany/a-50335521 (Deutsche Welle)] [https://techcrunch.com/2019/09/07/wikipedia-blames-malicious-ddos-attack-after-site-goes-down-across-europe-middle-east/ (TechCrunch)]
*The [[Indian Space Research Organization]] loses contact with [[Chandrayaan-2#Vikram lander|''Vikram'']] moments before its planned [[Soft landing (aeronautics)|soft landing]] on the [[Moon]]. [[India]] would have been the fourth nation to have [[List of missions to the Moon|explored the lunar surface]], had ''Vikram'' successfully landed, and it would have deployed the ''[[Pragyan (rover)|Pragyan]]'' rover onto the surface. [https://www.npr.org/2019/09/06/758419791/indias-attempt-to-land-rover-at-moon-s-south-pole-fails (NPR)]
